_comment: Models a workflow names that exist nowhere as the single file ComfyUI loads.
comfyui_models.py builds them from the repo given here instead of fetching the
workflow's URL. Keyed by <directory>/<name>, as the workflows name them.
repo, revision   the Hugging Face repo, pinned to a commit
shards           safetensors files in the repo, in order
rename           [from, to] prefix pairs applied to every tensor name
tensors, bytes   what the result must hold; anything else aborts the build

text_encoders/qwen3vl_8b_bf16_heretic.sa.about: Qwen-Image 2.1's text encoder (Qwen3-VL-8B) with refusals ablated by Heretic, bf16. The repo is a transformers checkpoint; ComfyUI's layout drops the language_model level. Nothing else differs: names, shapes and dtypes then match Comfy-Org's qwen3vl_8b_bf16.safetensors exactly.
